answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 9 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 470 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The canyon of the curve is the gate, the zenith of the reset is the trap, and the karst of the history is the asset no farm can print.
